notes: 2 Chronicles 35:8 8 And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred [small cattle], and three hundred oxen.
2 Chronicles 35:17 17 And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
